title: Layered config with typed env overrides
prompt: Write config.js exporting loadConfig(defaults, file = {}, env = {}). Start from defaults, apply the values in file on top, then environment variables on top of that. An env var applies when its name is 'APP_' followed by the key in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (maxRetries -> APP_MAX_RETRIES). Env values are strings, so convert them to the type of the default: numbers with Number() (throw an Error if that gives NaN), booleans from 'true'/'false' (throw for anything else), strings as they are. A key in file that is not in defaults throws an Error naming the key. Return a new object; do not change the inputs.
